item.name: 跑步不要穿 No Wear To Run

note.zh-TW: 這是台灣的線上商店與 App；台灣以外是否可用，本站未確認。
note.en: This is a Taiwan online shop and app; availability outside Taiwan was not checked.

label.zh-TW: App Store：No Wear To Run（開發者網站為 noweartorun.com）
label.en: App Store: No Wear To Run (developer website on noweartorun.com)

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟分享連結（bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the share link (a bmai.app short link; there is no code).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示下載 No Wear To Run App，請只安裝 App 商店中的官方版本。
steps.en: Follow the page to download the No Wear To Run app, and install only the official version from the app store.

steps.zh-TW: 開啟 App 後依指示註冊或登入會員。
steps.en: Open the app and register or log in as it directs.

intro.zh-TW: No Wear To Run 購物 App 的分享連結；分享文案沒有提到邀請碼或優惠。
intro.en: Share link for the No Wear To Run shopping app; the share text mentions no code or offer.

description.zh-TW:
No Wear To Run 是跑步運動服裝品牌，在台灣提供線上商店與購物 App，App 可免費下載。

本頁連結是分享文案中的 bmai.app 短網址，沒有邀請碼，是否綁定邀請人沒有查證。分享文案只寫「推薦你下載 跑步不要穿 App」，沒有提到優惠，所以不列優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
No Wear To Run is a running-apparel brand with an online shop and a shopping app in Taiwan; the app is free to download.

The link on this page is the bmai.app short link from the share text and it carries no invite code; whether it is tied to a referrer was not checked. The share text only recommends downloading the app and mentions no offer, so no offer is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 分享文案沒有邀請碼，也沒有優惠，連結原樣保留。bmai.app 是共用的第三方 App 連結服務，只因網站規則要求連結主機必須列入官方網域才列入；請不要把其他 bmai.app 網址當成官方連結。2026-10-24 以瀏覽器開啟，會轉到 noweartorun.com；邀請關係是否被接受，沒有測試。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。
notes.en: The share text has no invite code and no offer, and the link is kept exactly as shared. bmai.app is a shared third-party app-link service, listed only because the site's rules require the link host to be in the official domains; do not treat other bmai.app links as official links. Opened in a browser on 2026-10-24, it redirected to noweartorun.com; whether a referral is accepted was not tested. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

q.zh-TW: No Wear To Run 的分享連結需要輸入邀請碼嗎？
q.en: Do I need an invite code for the No Wear To Run share link?

a.zh-TW: 本站沒有邀請碼可提供：分享文案沒有邀請碼，請直接透過本頁連結開啟；App 註冊時是否有邀請碼欄位沒有查證。
a.en: This site has no invite code to give: the share text has none, so open the link on this page. Whether the app's sign-up has a code field was not checked.

q.zh-TW: 透過這條連結下載 App 有優惠嗎？
q.en: Is there an offer for downloading the app through this link?

a.zh-TW: 分享文案只推薦下載 App，沒有提到優惠；本站讀到的官方頁面也沒有說明邀請優惠，所以不列出優惠。
a.en: The share text only recommends the app and mentions no offer, and the official pages this site read describe no invite offer, so none is listed.
